# Production Project Instructions

Read this project's `production.json` and `context\Overview.md` before work.
They bind this local home to one existing ADO production project and artifact
namespace. Do not select another project from an engine-wide environment default.

Use the governing workspace's matching organization MCP and read the selected
board before implementation or creative work. Shared crew, skills, code and craft
grounding belong to the studio; project briefs, decisions, inputs and state belong
here. Do not copy the engine, import another production's context, or publish this
project to the engine's GitHub mirror.

Use the project-bound production runner for execution. Keep input files under
`inputs`, persistent local state under `state` and temporary output under
`.local\scratch`. Durable media stays in the existing output store by reference.
Do not infer a cast selection or approval from a file's age or a Done state.
The human Producer owns approval; check the board's explicit verdict.
